05 / Five-day setup

What happens in the first 5 days.

The setup target starts once requirements and access are agreed.

  1. DAY 1

    Fit check & requirements

  2. DAYS 2-3

    Build accounts, browsers, proxies, billing & access

  3. DAY 4

    Connect pages, domains & cloaking. Align creative.

  4. DAY 5

    Walkthrough, handover & launch plan

The 5-day target covers setup & handover, not guaranteed approval. Verification and platform review can take longer.
